meta.purpose: Golden retrieval set for the Aurea knowledge base. Each query is labelled with the source document(s) that genuinely answer it, by stable natural key (policy topic, room/venue code, KB title) — never by database id — so the labels survive a reseed. Metrics: hit@k, recall@k, precision@k, nDCG@k, MRR, computed for BM25-only and for the fused hybrid.
meta.relevance_note: A document is relevant to a case when it matches ANY predicate in `relevant`. Predicate keys: policyTopic | room | dining | kbTitle | category.
meta.labelled_against: data.db corpus (82 documents) as reindexed on 2026-08.
meta.relabelled: 2026-08-23: six cases relabelled to credit the Phase B verified facts (cable car, Cam Ranh airport, Akoya Spa, MICE). Those documents genuinely answer the query and carry an official source; the original labels simply predate them. Cases where the system ranks a document that does NOT answer the question were deliberately left failing.
